title: Portfolio Website
description: A modular React and TypeScript portfolio with reusable components, JSON-driven content, theme support, and GitHub Pages deployment.
details: A personal portfolio built to communicate professional experience and demonstrate hands-on web development. The application separates site content from presentation components so sections and projects can be updated without rewriting page layouts.
objective: Create a responsive, maintainable website that presents business analysis experience and technical projects clearly to recruiters.
approach: Organized the site into reusable React components and dedicated routes for About, Experience, Projects, Contact, and Resume.
Stored professional and project content in JSON files to simplify maintenance.
Implemented light and dark themes and responsive layouts for desktop and mobile.
Configured a Vite production build and a GitHub Actions workflow for GitHub Pages deployment.
challenges: Balanced a detailed homepage with separate pages so visitors can scan key information without losing access to deeper content.
Used a development branch to review changes before merging them into the published site.
GitHub Pages routing and direct-link refresh behavior still require deployment verification.
outcomes: A functioning multi-page portfolio with project listings, professional experience, and resume navigation.
The latest development-branch changes passed a local Vite production build.
Next: add authentic screenshots, test mobile layouts, and verify the published deployment.

title: Homelab Infrastructure

title: Stock Analytics Platform
